initial.title: Subscription capacity change
initial.context: Prepare a workspace capacity change from current seat demand, allocation limits, and prepaid credit. The component records a request and does not charge a payment method.
notes: Quota limits are inclusive. Ten seats is the first eligible Scale quantity.
Selecting another plan clears the billing term and capacity confirmation.

updates.title: Extended review: Subscription capacity change for the cross-functional welcome and operations programme
updates.context: Prepare a workspace capacity change from current seat demand, allocation limits, and prepaid credit. The component records a request and does not charge a payment method. Please read this caller-supplied narrative in full before recording the request. The facilities, people, and operations teams share this reusable panel, so the narrative may include several complete sentences and meaningful spaces. Every sentence must remain visible when the host scrolls; the panel must grow naturally instead of clipping, shrinking the type, or introducing an internal scroll region.
notes: Quota limits are inclusive. Ten seats is the first eligible Scale quantity.
Selecting another plan clears the billing term and capacity confirmation.

Caller note: keep the accessibility labels on the actual controls. Long descriptive text belongs in the component content and wraps across as many lines as necessary. This explanatory note is business context for the operator.
